name: Sektor44
research_notes: Large bouldering-focused centre (about 600 m2 floor, roughly 400 m2 of wall, 5th floor, entrance by the garage ramp). Instagram bio shows weekday and weekend hours and the account posts into Sept 2026 (new boulders set, national bouldering highlight). The old website sektor44.com returned 404 on every page when checked on 2026-10-01 (weebly error), so the Instagram profile is used as the website; the OSM node still lists the old domain. Operating company registered as Sektor44 Bouldering DOO since 2020.

name: Adrenalin Climbing Club
research_notes: Club-run centre inside the SPENS sports and business centre: a 300 m2 / 11.5 m rope wall (opened 2016) plus a separate 4 m bouldering hall (about 70 m2 per a 2022 local news item). Weekdays only, closed weekends except pre-booked sessions; hours differ in summer. Price list page shows a 2026 footer and Instagram posts run to Sept 2026 (course starting 21 Sept 2026). The site's own Google Maps pin is at 45.24784, 19.84403, within about 40 m of the OSM node. Walk-in daily self-training is priced, so treated as open to the public although club-operated.

name: SKC Baza Boulder Gym
research_notes: Bouldering hall inside the former brewery building of the SKC Baza cultural venue (the same Instagram account also advertises concerts). Bio gives daily hours; a new price list was posted in Oct 2025 and the account has posts through late Sept 2026. Memberships are card based. Has no separate website; Instagram used instead.

name: Pulse Climbing Hub
research_notes: Indoor hall in Senjak with daily opening hours in the Instagram bio, instructed courses (a top-rope belay course is described) and kids programmes; classes block some slots. A 2023 family-activity blog calls it a bouldering wall, but no primary post found states bouldering, so the field stays unknown. Directory lists a second address (Karadjordjev trg 11, Zemun), which the same operator uses for a separate outdoor Zemun wall in summer; not verified as a second indoor site.

name: PAEK Nis bouldering hall
address: Beogradska 22 (hall of the traffic-technical school 12. februar), 18000 Nis
research_notes: Club-run bouldering hall in the school sports hall; weekday evening sessions (19-21) with same-day online registration and per-session or monthly prices, so open to the public on booking but club-run. Coordinates come from the Google Maps embed on the club's own training page (pinned on the school). The OSM node for PAEK (43.3170, 21.9138) is the club entry about 2.5 km away and does not mark this hall, so it was not used. The site has dated posts up to the national bouldering championship held in Nis on 21 Dec 2025; the training page itself is undated.
